summary: The focused object printing claim does not require harness maintenance. Every parser-produced object accepted by the old harness has a container depth below the threshold checked by the new printer.

claims.necessity_reason: The harness prints only trees returned by cJSON_ParseWithOpts. Parsing and printing start at depth zero; every parsed array or object passes the same CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT check that the new object printer uses.

before.requirement: Print a parser-produced object at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting it solely for depth.
before.reason: The complete old object printer has no depth rejection, and the harness passes its parsed tree to a print call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete parser dispatch routes container input through parse_array or parse_object.
Array parsing applies the shared nesting limit.
Object parsing applies the shared nesting limit.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced object at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting it solely for depth.
after.reason: The new object print guard rejects depths already rejected by container parsing. Both print routes begin at depth zero, and array printing counts mixed container nesting.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete parser dispatch routes container input through parse_array or parse_object.
Array parsing rejects a container at the printer's threshold.
Object parsing rejects a container at the printer's threshold.
Array printing applies the same threshold and increments depth for mixed nesting.
Unbuffered printing initializes depth to zero.
Buffered printing initializes depth to zero.

claims.comparison_reason: The same old harness parses the tree and prints it on both sides. The new guard cannot reject the depth of a parser-accepted object.
